title: **Gharibabadi: US Leads World in Human Rights Violations, Escalating Abuses While Evading Accountability**
text:
**Gharibabadi: US Leads World in Human Rights Violations, Escalating Abuses While Evading Accountability**"

"Iran’s Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs, Kazem Gharibabadi, stated that the United States is the global frontrunner and leader in the field of human rights violations, adding that the more the US engages in rights-violating behaviors, the more it evades accountability.
